# Pinocchio ABA with Mobile Base Side Constraint Abnormality: First Check What?

> **Current answer:** First check the generalized force reference coordinate system at the base. The root cause is misinterpreting the generalized force of the base as part of the machine system, when it should be interpreted in the world frame; correcting this leads the original author to confirm the system is working. If further strict coupling of constraint force and acceleration is required, consider equality constraints using QP.

## Key terms

- Forward Dynamics (前向动力学)
- Coordinate Frame (坐标系)
- Quadratic Programming (QP) (二次规划)

## Problem and symptoms

- The control strategy did not comply with the side-zero velocity constraint on the mobile base.
- There is a contradiction in the calculation of the side force on the base and local y velocity.

## Environment

- Pinocchio, planar root joint, ABA, two-wheel differential drive mobile robot.

## Priority diagnostics

- Each generalized coordinate, generalized velocity, and generalized force component was verified for the reference coordinate system.

## Possible causes

- Misinterpreting the base force moment from the ABA input as part of the machine system, when it should be interpreted in the world frame.

## Attempts

- The author checked the joint Jacobian, velocity derivatives, and forward dynamics interface before constraints.

## Effective fixes

- The base generalized force was reinterpreted and constructed in the world coordinate system.

## Result

- The original author confirmed the code works after correcting the coordinate system understanding.

## Limitations

- The strict equality constraint coupling of constraint force and acceleration still may require QP; this case ultimately fixes the coordinate system misunderstanding.

## Safety notes

- Before real-world testing of the baseplate, perform coordinate system unit tests for each generalized force component.
